mechanism: Armodafinil inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, potentially increasing amitriptyline plasma concentrations and CNS stimulant effects may antagonize tricyclic antidepressant therapeutic benefit.
action: Monitor for amitriptyline toxicity (anticholinergic effects, cardiac arrhythmias, seizures); consider amitriptyline dose reduction; assess clinical response to depression treatment.
